newsitem.title: USA: Chase invests $4.8 bln in communities in 96.
newsitem.headline: Chase invests $4.8 bln in communities in 96.

text.p: The Chase Manhattan Corp said Thursday it made $4.8 billion worth of community development loans and investments in the United States in 1996 as part of its five-year $18.1 billion commitment.
Of the five-year total, the company said $4.2 billion was targeted to go to New York State, with $3.2 billion for New York City.
The company said the community investment program is a voluntary one and is not tied by a formula to the company's financial results.

The major items in this year's commitment include $1.2 billion in affordable housing, $3.4 billion to help small businesses with annual revenues of less than $1 million and small not-for-profit organizations, $13.5 billion in affordable mortgages nationwide, and $70 million in grants to smaller not-for-profit organizations.
